scope: Six additional source-reviewed editions under an earlier published key. No first historical decipherment or new key recovery is claimed. Names, unit numerals, references and editorial repairs are distinguished. No p73 plaintext or cross-period key assignment is inferred.

external_catalogue_context.claim: The institutional catalogue records the1922 regimental history with contributors Karl von Grundherr and August Graf von Freyen-Seyboltstorff. This corroborates names and publication metadata only; the book pages have not been inspected.
external_catalogue_context.retrieval_limit: The WLB page returned an automated-access denial. No date or movement from the book is asserted.
